```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
```

# Figure 7

## Figure 7A & 7B

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# Define colors
# --------------------------------------------------

set_colors <- c(
  "Elite controller" = "#5A588B",
  "More preserved immunity" = "#C89A1B",
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#EABBBB",
  "Primary HIV infection" = "#4B988F"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare plot data
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  group_by(ID, Subgroup) |>
  summarise(
    `CD4 cell count (baseline)`   = mean(`CD4 cell count (baseline)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`    = mean(`CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `CD4 cell count (follow-up)`  = mean(`CD4 cell count (follow-up)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`   = mean(`CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ID, Subgroup),
    names_to = c("Variable", "Timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(.*) \\((baseline|follow-up)\\)",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Variable,
    values_from = Value
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(
      Timepoint,
      "baseline" = "Baseline",
      "follow-up" = "Follow-up"
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up")),

    Subgroup = factor(
      Subgroup,
      levels = c(
        "Elite controller",
        "More preserved immunity",
        "Severely impaired immunity",
        "Primary HIV infection"
      )
    ),

    CD4_category = case_when(
      `CD4 cell count` < 350 ~ "Very low",
      `CD4 cell count` >= 350 & `CD4 cell count` < 500 ~ "Low",
      `CD4 cell count` >= 500 ~ "Normal",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    CD4CD8_category = case_when(
      `CD4/CD8 ratio` < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
      `CD4/CD8 ratio` >= 0.5 & `CD4/CD8 ratio` < 1 ~ "Low",
      `CD4/CD8 ratio` >= 1 ~ "Normal",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Guideline_concordance = case_when(
      CD4_category == CD4CD8_category ~ paste0("Concordant: ", CD4_category),
      CD4_category != CD4CD8_category ~ "Discordant category",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Guideline_concordance = factor(
      Guideline_concordance,
      levels = c(
        "Concordant: Very low",
        "Concordant: Low",
        "Concordant: Normal",
        "Discordant category"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`CD4 cell count`),
    !is.na(`CD4/CD8 ratio`),
    !is.na(Guideline_concordance)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_cd4_cd8 <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = `CD4 cell count`,
    y = `CD4/CD8 ratio`,
    color = Subgroup,
    shape = Guideline_concordance
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(350, 500), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    inherit.aes = TRUE
  ) +
  stat_cor(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "spearman",
    color = "black",
    label.x.npc = "left",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = set_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Concordant: Very low" = 16,
      "Concordant: Low" = 17,
      "Concordant: Normal" = 15,
      "Discordant category" = 4
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "CD4 T-cell count",
    y = "CD4/CD8 T-cell count ratio",
    color = NULL,
    shape = "CD4 and CD4/CD8 guideline agreement"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_cd4_cd8

# --------------------------------------------------
# Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/scatter", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/scatter", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/scatter/CD4_count_vs_CD4CD8_ratio_baseline_followup_guidelines.pdf",
  p_cd4_cd8,
  width = 20,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/scatter/CD4_count_vs_CD4CD8_ratio_baseline_followup_guidelines.png",
  p_cd4_cd8,
  width = 20,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Figure 7C

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# Define colors
# --------------------------------------------------

set_colors <- c(
  "More preserved immunity" = "#C89A1B",
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#EABBBB",
  "Primary HIV infection" = "#4B988F"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Plot Delta CD4 vs Delta CD4/CD8
# --------------------------------------------------

p_delta_cd4_cd8 <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  filter(Subgroup != "Elite controller") |>
  group_by(ID, Subgroup) |>
  summarise(
    CD4_baseline      = mean(`CD4 cell count (baseline)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    CD4_followup      = mean(`CD4 cell count (follow-up)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    CD4CD8_baseline   = mean(`CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    CD4CD8_followup   = mean(`CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Delta_CD4 = CD4_followup - CD4_baseline,
    Delta_CD4_CD8 = CD4CD8_followup - CD4CD8_baseline,

    Subgroup = factor(
      Subgroup,
      levels = c(
        "More preserved immunity",
        "Severely impaired immunity",
        "Primary HIV infection"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Delta_CD4),
    !is.na(Delta_CD4_CD8),
    is.finite(Delta_CD4),
    is.finite(Delta_CD4_CD8)
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = Delta_CD4,
      y = Delta_CD4_CD8,
      color = Subgroup
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  stat_cor(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "spearman",
    color = "black",
    label.x.npc = "left",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = set_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = expression(Delta~"CD4 cell count"),
    y = expression(Delta~"CD4/CD8 ratio")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_delta_cd4_cd8

# --------------------------------------------------
# Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/scatter", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/scatter", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/scatter/Delta_CD4_vs_Delta_CD4CD8.pdf",
  p_delta_cd4_cd8,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/scatter/Delta_CD4_vs_Delta_CD4CD8.png",
  p_delta_cd4_cd8,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Figure 7D

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease %in% c("HIV")) |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up") |>
  rename(CD4_cell_count_baseline = `CD4 cell count (baseline)`) |>
  mutate(Age = `Age (baseline)`)

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "CD4_cell_count_baseline", 
                          case = NULL, 
                          correct = c("Sex", "Age")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0,
                  top_up_prot = 20,
                  top_down_prot = 20,
                  title = "CD4 T-cell count (at baseline)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

de_res_cd4_baseline <- de_results$de_res

p_cd4_baseline <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    x = expression(log[2]("fold change"))
  )

p_cd4_baseline$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p_cd4_baseline$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p_cd4_baseline$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p_cd4_baseline

de_res_cd4_baseline |> filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) |> nrow()
de_res_cd4_baseline |> filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < -0) |> nrow()
```

```{r}
library(ggvenn)

# 1. Define thresholds

logfc_cutoff <- 0

# --------------------------------------------------

# --------------------------------------------------

  "CD4 cell count\nbaseline" =
    de_res_cd4_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>

  fill_color = c("#4B988F", "#5A588B"),

  theme_void()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Thresholds
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define sets
# --------------------------------------------------

cd4_set <- de_res_cd4_baseline |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
  pull(Feature) |>
  unique()

cd4_cd8_set <- de_res_cd4_cd8_baseline |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
  pull(Feature) |>
  unique()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Overlap / non-overlap
# --------------------------------------------------

overlap_proteins <- intersect(cd4_set, cd4_cd8_set)
cd4_only         <- setdiff(cd4_set, cd4_cd8_set)
cd4_cd8_only     <- setdiff(cd4_cd8_set, cd4_set)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Pretty printing function
# --------------------------------------------------

print_protein_set <- function(title, vec) {
  cat("\n====================================\n")
  cat(title, " (n =", length(vec), ")\n")
  cat("====================================\n")
  
  if (length(vec) == 0) {
    cat("None\n")
  } else {
    cat(paste(sort(vec), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Print results
# --------------------------------------------------

cat("\n\n########## OVERLAP SUMMARY ##########\n")

print_protein_set("CD4 cell count ONLY", cd4_only)
print_protein_set("CD4/CD8 ratio ONLY", cd4_cd8_only)
print_protein_set("OVERLAPPING PROTEINS", overlap_proteins)

cat("\n####################################\n\n")
```

## Figure 7G

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare metadata and data
# --------------------------------------------------

input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Timepoint == "Baseline",
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subgroup != "Elite controller"
  ) |>
  rename(
    CD4_FU = `CD4 cell count (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(CD4_FU))

input_data <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(
  dat = input_data,
  metadata = input_metadata,
  is_wide = TRUE,
  sample_id = "DAid",
  var_name = "Feature",
  value_name = "NPX"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Generate and save reproducible random seeds
# --------------------------------------------------

set.seed(12345)

n_splits <- 100

split_seeds <- sample(
  x = 1:1000000,
  size = n_splits,
  replace = FALSE
)

seed_df <- tibble(
  split = paste0("split_", seq_len(n_splits)),
  seed = split_seeds
)

dir.create("../tables/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  seed_df,
  "../tables/model/CD4_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_split_seeds.csv"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run 100 models
# --------------------------------------------------

model_results_cd4_fu <- vector("list", length = n_splits)
split_objects_cd4_fu <- vector("list", length = n_splits)

for (i in seq_len(n_splits)) {

  current_seed <- split_seeds[i]

  message("Running split ", i, "/", n_splits, " with seed ", current_seed)

  hd_split <- hd_split_data(
    hd_obj,
    variable = "CD4_FU",
    metadata_cols = NULL,
    ratio = 0.7,
    seed = current_seed
  )

  split_objects_cd4_fu[[i]] <- hd_split

  model_results_cd4_fu[[i]] <- hd_model_rreg(
    dat = hd_split,
    variable = "CD4_FU",
    case = NULL,
    control = NULL,
    balance_groups = TRUE,
    cor_threshold = 1,
    grid_size = 30,
    cv_sets = 5,
    mixture = 1,
    palette = NULL,
    plot_y_labels = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE,
    plot_title = c("rmse", "rsq", "features", "mixture"),
    seed = current_seed
  )
}

names(model_results_cd4_fu) <- seed_df$split
names(split_objects_cd4_fu) <- seed_df$split

saveRDS(
  model_results_cd4_fu,
  "../tables/model/CD4_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_model_results.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  split_objects_cd4_fu,
  "../tables/model/CD4_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_split_objects.rds"
)
```

```{r}
model_results_cd4_fu <- readRDS("../tables/model/CD4_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_model_results.rds")
split_objects_cd4_fu <- readRDS("../tables/model/CD4_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_split_objects.rds")
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract feature importance from all splits
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_cd4_fu <- imap_dfr(
  model_results_cd4_fu,
  function(model, split_name) {
    model$features |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)
  }
)

feature_importance_cd4_fu <- feature_importance_cd4_fu |>
  filter(Scaled_Importance > 0) |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  mutate(
    n_selected = n_distinct(Split),
    selection_frequency = n_selected / n_splits
  ) |>
  ungroup()

feature_importance_cd4_fu_filtered <- feature_importance_cd4_fu |>
  filter(n_selected > 5)

top_features_cd4_fu <- feature_importance_cd4_fu_filtered |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(Scaled_Importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_importance = median(Scaled_Importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_selected = max(n_selected, na.rm = TRUE),
    selection_frequency = max(selection_frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_importance, n = 25)

plot_df_cd4_fu <- feature_importance_cd4_fu_filtered |>
  semi_join(top_features_cd4_fu, by = "Feature") |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = paste0(Feature, " (n=", n_selected, ")")
  )

feature_order <- plot_df_cd4_fu |>
  group_by(Feature_label) |>
  summarise(
    median_importance = median(Scaled_Importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_importance) |>
  pull(Feature_label)

plot_df_cd4_fu <- plot_df_cd4_fu |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = factor(Feature_label, levels = feature_order)
  )

p_feature_stability_cd4_fu <- ggplot(
  plot_df_cd4_fu,
  aes(
    x = Feature_label,
    y = Scaled_Importance
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.85,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "grey85",
    color = "black"
  ) +
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df_cd4_fu <- purrr::imap_dfr(

)

metrics_long_cd4_fu <- metrics_df_cd4_fu |>

  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1     = quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),

    Min    = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),

metric_split_labels_cd4_fu <- metrics_long_cd4_fu |>
  left_join(metrics_summary_long_cd4_fu, by = "Metric") |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median_split = Split[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],
    Median_split_value = Value[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],

    Min_split = Split[which.min(Value)],
    Min_split_value = Value[which.min(Value)],

    Max_split = Split[which.max(Value)],
    Max_split_value = Value[which.max(Value)],

    .groups = "drop"
  )

metrics_summary_long_cd4_fu <- metrics_summary_long_cd4_fu |>
  left_join(metric_split_labels_cd4_fu, by = "Metric")
```

## Figure 7I

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare prediction dataframe
# --------------------------------------------------

pred_df <- optimal_model_cd4_fu$comparison_plot$data |>
  mutate(
    .pred  = as.numeric(.pred),
    CD4_FU = as.numeric(CD4_FU)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(.pred),
    !is.na(CD4_FU),
    is.finite(.pred),
    is.finite(CD4_FU)
  )

# 🔥 Extract R²
rsq_optimal_cd4 <- optimal_model_summary_cd4_fu$rsq

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit linear model
# --------------------------------------------------

lm_fit <- lm(CD4_FU ~ .pred, data = pred_df)

pred_df <- pred_df |>
  mutate(
    fitted_line = predict(lm_fit, newdata = pred_df),
    distance_to_line = abs(CD4_FU - fitted_line)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define CD4 categories
# --------------------------------------------------

pred_df <- pred_df |>
  mutate(
    observed_category = case_when(
      CD4_FU < 350 ~ "Very low",
      CD4_FU < 500 ~ "Low",
      CD4_FU >= 500 ~ "Normal"
    ),

    predicted_category = case_when(
      .pred < 350 ~ "Very low",
      .pred < 500 ~ "Low",
      .pred >= 500 ~ "Normal"
    ),

    prediction_concordance = if_else(
      observed_category == predicted_category,
      "Concordant category",
      "Discordant category"
    ),

    prediction_concordance = factor(
      prediction_concordance,
      levels = c("Concordant category", "Discordant category")
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Scatter plot (FIXED)
# --------------------------------------------------

p_pred_cd4 <- ggplot(
  pred_df,
  aes(x = .pred, y = CD4_FU)
) +
  
  # Thresholds
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(350, 500),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(350, 500),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Points (mapping moved here 🔥)
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = distance_to_line,
      shape = prediction_concordance
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 SINGLE regression line
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 R² annotation
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = quantile(pred_df$.pred, 0.05),
    y = quantile(pred_df$CD4_FU, 0.95),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(rsq_optimal_cd4, 3)),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Concordant category" = 16,
      "Discordant category" = 4
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "grey80",
    high = "#C03830",
    name = "Distance to\nregression line"
  ) +
  
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted vs observed follow-up CD4 cell count",
    subtitle = "Shape indicates concordance of predicted vs observed CD4 categories",
    x = "Predicted CD4 T-cell count at follow-up",
    y = "Observed CD4 T-cell count at follow-up",
    shape = "Prediction category"
  ) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_pred_cd4

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Predicted_vs_observed_CD4_FU_concordance.pdf",

  height = 7
)

ggsave(
```

## Figure 7J

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare metadata and data
# --------------------------------------------------

input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Timepoint == "Baseline",
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subgroup != "Elite controller"
  ) |>
  rename(
    CD4_CD8_FU = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(CD4_CD8_FU))

input_data <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(
  dat = input_data,
  metadata = input_metadata,
  is_wide = TRUE,
  sample_id = "DAid",
  var_name = "Feature",
  value_name = "NPX"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Generate and save reproducible random seeds
# --------------------------------------------------

set.seed(12345)

n_splits <- 100

split_seeds <- sample(
  x = 1:1000000,
  size = n_splits,
  replace = FALSE
)

seed_df <- tibble(
  split = paste0("split_", seq_len(n_splits)),
  seed = split_seeds
)

dir.create("../tables/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  seed_df,
  "../tables/model/CD4_CD8_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_split_seeds.csv"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run 100 models
# --------------------------------------------------

model_results_cd4_cd8_fu <- vector("list", length = n_splits)
split_objects_cd4_cd8_fu <- vector("list", length = n_splits)

for (i in seq_len(n_splits)) {

  current_seed <- split_seeds[i]

  message("Running split ", i, "/", n_splits, " with seed ", current_seed)

  hd_split <- hd_split_data(
    hd_obj,
    variable = "CD4_CD8_FU",
    metadata_cols = NULL,
    ratio = 0.7,
    seed = current_seed
  )

  split_objects_cd4_cd8_fu[[i]] <- hd_split

  model_results_cd4_cd8_fu[[i]] <- hd_model_rreg(
    dat = hd_split,
    variable = "CD4_CD8_FU",
    case = NULL,
    control = NULL,
    balance_groups = TRUE,
    cor_threshold = 1,
    grid_size = 30,
    cv_sets = 5,
    mixture = 1,
    palette = NULL,
    plot_y_labels = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE,
    plot_title = c("rmse", "rsq", "features", "mixture"),
    seed = current_seed
  )
}

names(model_results_cd4_cd8_fu) <- seed_df$split
names(split_objects_cd4_cd8_fu) <- seed_df$split

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Save model objects
# --------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  model_results_cd4_cd8_fu,
  "../tables/model/CD4_CD8_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_model_results.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  split_objects_cd4_cd8_fu,
  "../tables/model/CD4_CD8_FU_baseline_proteomics_100_split_objects.rds"
)
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract metrics per split
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results_cd4_cd8_fu,
  function(model, split_name) {
    tibble(
      Split = split_name,
      rsq  = as.numeric(model$metrics$rsq),
      rmse = as.numeric(model$metrics$rmse)
    )
  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert to long format
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_long <- metrics_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rsq, rmse),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Summary statistics
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_summary_long <- metrics_long |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1     = quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3     = quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min    = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max    = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Identify median/min/max split per metric
# --------------------------------------------------

metric_split_labels <- metrics_long |>
  left_join(metrics_summary_long, by = "Metric") |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median_split = Split[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],
    Median_split_value = Value[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],

    Min_split = Split[which.min(Value)],
    Min_split_value = Value[which.min(Value)],

    Max_split = Split[which.max(Value)],
    Max_split_value = Value[which.max(Value)],

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Combine summary + split labels
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_summary_long <- metrics_summary_long |>
  left_join(metric_split_labels, by = "Metric")

metrics_summary_long
```

```{r}
  pred_df,
  aes(
    x = .pred,
    y = CD4_CD8_FU
  )
) +
  
  # Threshold lines
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(0.5, 1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(0.5, 1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Points (color + shape applied HERE, not globally)
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = distance_to_line,
      shape = prediction_concordance
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 SINGLE regression line (FIXED)
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # R² annotation
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = quantile(pred_df$.pred, 0.05),
    y = quantile(pred_df$CD4_CD8_FU, 0.95),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(rsq_optimal_cd4_cd8, 3)),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Concordant category" = 16,
      "Discordant category" = 4
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "grey80",
    high = "#C03830",
    name = "Distance to\nregression line"
  ) +
  
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted vs observed follow-up CD4/CD8 ratio",
    subtitle = "Shape indicates concordance of predicted vs observed category",
    x = "Predicted CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)",
    y = "Observed CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)",
    shape = "Prediction category"
  ) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_pred_cd4_cd8

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Predicted_vs_observed_CD4_CD8_FU_concordance.pdf",
  p_pred_cd4_cd8,
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/model/Predicted_vs_observed_CD4_CD8_FU_concordance.png",
  p_pred_cd4_cd8,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# For follow-up
library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define thresholds
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create significant protein sets
# --------------------------------------------------

venn_sets_all <- list(
  "CD4 cell count\nfollow-up" =
    de_res_cd4_fu |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature) |>
    unique(),

  "CD4/CD8 ratio\nfollow-up" =
    de_res_cd4_cd8_fu |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature) |>
    unique()
)

# Sanity check
sapply(venn_sets_all, length)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Fit Euler diagram
# --------------------------------------------------

fit_all <- euler(venn_sets_all)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

plot(
  fit_all,
  fills = list(
    fill = c("#4B988F", "#5A588B"),
    alpha = 0.6
  ),
  edges = list(
    col = "black",
    lwd = 1
  ),
  labels = list(
    fontsize = 14
  ),
  quantities = list(
    fontsize = 14
  ),
  main = "Overlap of significant proteins\nCD4 count vs CD4/CD8 ratio at follow-up"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save plots
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/overlap", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/overlap", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf("../plots/pdf/overlap/venn_cd4_cd4cd8_fu_all_sig.pdf",
    width = 7, height = 7)

plot(
  fit_all,
  fills = list(fill = c("#4B988F", "#5A588B"), alpha = 0.6),
  edges = list(col = "black", lwd = 1),
  labels = list(fontsize = 14),
  quantities = list(fontsize = 14),
  main = "Overlap of significant proteins\nCD4 count vs CD4/CD8 ratio at follow-up"
)

dev.off()

png("../plots/png/overlap/venn_cd4_cd4cd8_fu_all_sig.png",
    width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)

plot(
  fit_all,
  fills = list(fill = c("#4B988F", "#5A588B"), alpha = 0.6),
  edges = list(col = "black", lwd = 1),
  labels = list(fontsize = 14),
  quantities = list(fontsize = 14),

)
```

## Figure S16F

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Extract and summarise model metrics
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df_cd4_cd8_fu <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results_cd4_cd8_fu,
  function(model, split_name) {
    tibble(
      Split = split_name,
      rsq  = as.numeric(model$metrics$rsq),
      rmse = as.numeric(model$metrics$rmse)
    )
  }
)

metrics_long_cd4_cd8_fu <- metrics_df_cd4_cd8_fu |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rsq, rmse),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

metrics_summary_long_cd4_cd8_fu <- metrics_long_cd4_cd8_fu |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1     = quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3     = quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min    = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max    = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

metric_split_labels_cd4_cd8_fu <- metrics_long_cd4_cd8_fu |>
  left_join(metrics_summary_long_cd4_fu, by = "Metric") |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median_split = Split[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],
    Median_split_value = Value[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],

    Min_split = Split[which.min(Value)],
    Min_split_value = Value[which.min(Value)],

    Max_split = Split[which.max(Value)],
    Max_split_value = Value[which.max(Value)],

    .groups = "drop"
  )

metrics_summary_long_cd4_cd8_fu <- metrics_summary_long_cd4_cd8_fu |>
  left_join(metric_split_labels_cd4_cd8_fu, by = "Metric")

metrics_summary_long_cd4_cd8_fu

write_csv(
  metrics_df_cd4_cd8_fu,
  "../tables/model/CD4_cd8_FU_metrics_per_split.csv"
)

write_csv(
  metrics_long_cd4_cd8_fu,
  "../tables/model/CD4_cd8_FU_metrics_per_split_long.csv"
)

write_csv(
  metrics_summary_long_cd4_cd8_fu,
  "../tables/model/CD4_cd8_FU_metrics_summary_long.csv"
)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)

# ==================================================
# 1. Define thresholds
# ==================================================

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0

# ==================================================
# 2. Create significant protein sets (Δ BASELINE)
# ==================================================

venn_sets_delta <- list(
  
  "Δ CD4\n(baseline)" =
    de_res_delta_cd4_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature) |>
    unique(),
  
  "Δ CD4/CD8\n(baseline)" =
    de_res_delta_cd4cd8_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature) |>
    unique()
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Sanity check
# --------------------------------------------------

sapply(venn_sets_delta, length)

# ==================================================
# 3. Fit Euler diagram
# ==================================================

fit_delta <- euler(venn_sets_delta)

# ==================================================
# 4. Plot
# ==================================================

plot(
  fit_delta,
  fills = list(
    fill = c("#4B988F", "#5A588B"),  # keep your HIV palette
    alpha = 0.6
  ),
  edges = list(
    col = "black",
    lwd = 1
  ),
  labels = list(
    fontsize = 14
  ),
  quantities = list(
    fontsize = 14
  ),
  main = "Overlap of significant proteins\nΔ CD4 vs Δ CD4/CD8 (baseline)"
)

# ==================================================
# 5. Save plots
# ==================================================

dir.create("../plots/pdf/overlap", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/overlap", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/venn_delta_cd4_cd4cd8_baseline.pdf",

)

plot(

  edges = list(col = "black", lwd = 1),
  labels = list(fontsize = 14),
  quantities = list(fontsize = 14),
  main = "Overlap of significant proteins\nΔ CD4 vs Δ CD4/CD8 (baseline)"
)

dev.off()

png(
  "../plots/png/overlap/venn_delta_cd4_cd4cd8_baseline.png",

  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

plot(
```

## Figure S17D

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare metadata and data
# --------------------------------------------------

input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Timepoint == "Baseline",
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subgroup != "Elite controller"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Delta_CD4 = `CD4 cell count (follow-up)` - `CD4 cell count (baseline)`
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Delta_CD4))

input_data <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(
  dat = input_data,
  metadata = input_metadata,
  is_wide = TRUE,
  sample_id = "DAid",
  var_name = "Feature",
  value_name = "NPX"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Generate and save reproducible random seeds
# --------------------------------------------------

set.seed(12345)

n_splits <- 100

split_seeds <- sample(
  x = 1:1000000,
  size = n_splits,
  replace = FALSE
)

seed_df <- tibble(
  split = paste0("split_", seq_len(n_splits)),
  seed = split_seeds
)

dir.create("../tables/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  seed_df,
  "../tables/model/Delta_CD4_CD8_baseline_proteomics_100_split_seeds.csv"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run 100 models
# --------------------------------------------------

model_results_delta_cd4_cd8 <- vector("list", length = n_splits)
split_objects_delta_cd4_cd8 <- vector("list", length = n_splits)

for (i in seq_len(n_splits)) {

  current_seed <- split_seeds[i]

  message("Running split ", i, "/", n_splits, " with seed ", current_seed)

  hd_split <- hd_split_data(
    hd_obj,
    variable = "Delta_CD4",
    metadata_cols = NULL,
    ratio = 0.7,
    seed = current_seed
  )

  split_objects_delta_cd4[[i]] <- hd_split

  model_results_delta_cd4[[i]] <- hd_model_rreg(
    dat = hd_split,
    variable = "Delta_CD4",
    case = NULL,
    control = NULL,
    balance_groups = TRUE,
    cor_threshold = 1,
    grid_size = 30,
    cv_sets = 5,
    mixture = 1,
    palette = NULL,
    plot_y_labels = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE,
    plot_title = c("rmse", "rsq", "features", "mixture"),
    seed = current_seed
  )
}

names(model_results_delta_cd4) <- seed_df$split
names(split_objects_delta_cd4) <- seed_df$split

saveRDS(
  model_results_delta_cd4,
  "../tables/model/Delta_CD4_baseline_proteomics_100_model_results.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  split_objects_delta_cd4,
  "../tables/model/Delta_CD4_baseline_proteomics_100_split_objects.rds"
)
```

```{r}
model_results_delta_cd4 <- readRDS("../tables/model/Delta_CD4_baseline_proteomics_100_model_results.rds")
split_objects_delta_cd4 <- readRDS("../tables/model/Delta_CD4_baseline_proteomics_100_split_objects.rds")
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Feature-selection stability
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_delta_cd4 <- imap_dfr(
  model_results_delta_cd4,
  function(model, split_name) {
    model$features |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)
  }
)

feature_importance_delta_cd4 <- feature_importance_delta_cd4 |>
  filter(Scaled_Importance > 0) |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  mutate(
    n_selected = n_distinct(Split),
    selection_frequency = n_selected / n_splits
  ) |>
  ungroup()

feature_importance_delta_cd4_filtered <- feature_importance_delta_cd4 |>
  filter(n_selected > 5)

top_features_delta_cd4 <- feature_importance_delta_cd4_filtered |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(Scaled_Importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_importance = median(Scaled_Importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_selected = max(n_selected, na.rm = TRUE),
    selection_frequency = max(selection_frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_importance, n = 25)

plot_df_delta_cd4 <- feature_importance_delta_cd4_filtered |>
  semi_join(top_features_delta_cd4, by = "Feature") |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = paste0(Feature, " (n=", n_selected, ")")
  )

feature_order <- plot_df_delta_cd4 |>
  group_by(Feature_label) |>
  summarise(
    median_importance = median(Scaled_Importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_importance) |>
  pull(Feature_label)

plot_df_delta_cd4 <- plot_df_delta_cd4 |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = factor(Feature_label, levels = feature_order)
  )

p_feature_stability_delta_cd4 <- ggplot(
  plot_df_delta_cd4,
  aes(
    x = Feature_label,
    y = Scaled_Importance
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.85,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "grey85",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Protein importance stability across 100 splits",
    subtitle = "Prediction of ΔCD4 ratio using baseline proteomics",
    x = "Protein",
    y = "Scaled feature importance"
  )

p_feature_stability_delta_cd4
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df_delta_cd4 <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results_delta_cd4,
  function(model, split_name) {
    tibble(
      Split = split_name,
      rsq  = as.numeric(model$metrics$rsq),
      rmse = as.numeric(model$metrics$rmse)
    )
  }
)

metrics_long_delta_cd4 <- metrics_df_delta_cd4 |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rsq, rmse),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

metrics_summary_long_delta_cd4 <- metrics_long_delta_cd4 |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1     = quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3     = quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min    = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max    = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

metric_split_labels_delta_cd4 <- metrics_long_delta_cd4 |>
  left_join(metrics_summary_long_delta_cd4_cd8, by = "Metric") |>
  group_by(Metric) |>
  summarise(
    Median_split = Split[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],
    Median_split_value = Value[which.min(abs(Value - Median))],

    Min_split = Split[which.min(Value)],
    Min_split_value = Value[which.min(Value)],

    Max_split = Split[which.max(Value)],
    Max_split_value = Value[which.max(Value)],

    .groups = "drop"
  )

metrics_summary_long_delta_cd4 <- metrics_summary_long_delta_cd4 |>
  left_join(metric_split_labels_delta_cd4, by = "Metric")

metrics_summary_long_delta_cd4
```

## Figure S17F

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare prediction dataframe
# --------------------------------------------------

pred_df <- optimal_model_delta_cd4$comparison_plot$data |>
  mutate(
    .pred  = as.numeric(.pred),
    Delta_CD4 = as.numeric(Delta_CD4)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(.pred),
    !is.na(Delta_CD4),
    is.finite(.pred),
    is.finite(Delta_CD4)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit linear model and calculate distance to line
# --------------------------------------------------

lm_fit <- lm(Delta_CD4 ~ .pred, data = pred_df)

# 🔥 Compute R² (robust way)
rsq_optimal_delta_cd4 <- summary(lm_fit)$r.squared

pred_df <- pred_df |>
  mutate(
    fitted_line = predict(lm_fit, newdata = pred_df),
    distance_to_line = abs(Delta_CD4 - fitted_line)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Scatter plot (UPDATED)
# --------------------------------------------------

p_pred_delta_cd4 <- ggplot(
  pred_df,
  aes(
    x = .pred,
    y = Delta_CD4,
    color = distance_to_line
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 SINGLE regression line (no duplication)
  geom_abline(
    slope = coef(lm_fit)[2],
    intercept = coef(lm_fit)[1],
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 R² annotation instead of stat_cor
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(pred_df$.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(pred_df$Delta_CD4, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(rsq_optimal_delta_cd4, 3)),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "grey80",
    high = "#C03830",
    name = "Distance to\nregression line"
  ) +
  
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted vs observed ΔCD4 ratio",
    subtitle = "Baseline proteomics prediction",
    x = "Predicted ΔCD4",
    y = "Observed ΔCD4"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_pred_delta_cd4

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Predicted_vs_observed_delta_CD4_R2.pdf",
  p_pred_delta_cd4,
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(

)
```

```{r}
  ) |>
  arrange(median_importance) |>
  pull(Feature_label)

plot_df_delta_cd4_cd8 <- plot_df_delta_cd4_cd8 |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = factor(Feature_label, levels = feature_order)
  )

p_feature_stability_delta_cd4_cd8 <- ggplot(
  plot_df_delta_cd4_cd8,
  aes(
    x = Feature_label,
    y = Scaled_Importance
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.85,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "grey85",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Protein importance stability across 100 splits",
    subtitle = "Prediction of ΔCD4/CD8 ratio using baseline proteomics",
    x = "Protein",
    y = "Scaled feature importance"
  )

p_feature_stability_delta_cd4_cd8
```

```{r}
    Min_split = Split[which.min(Value)],
    Min_split_value = Value[which.min(Value)],

    Max_split = Split[which.max(Value)],
    Max_split_value = Value[which.max(Value)],

    .groups = "drop"
  )

metrics_summary_long_delta_cd4_cd8 <- metrics_summary_long_delta_cd4_cd8 |>
```

## Figure S17I

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare prediction dataframe
# --------------------------------------------------

pred_df <- optimal_model_delta_cd4_cd8$comparison_plot$data |>
  mutate(
    .pred  = as.numeric(.pred),
    Delta_CD4_CD8 = as.numeric(Delta_CD4_CD8)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(.pred),
    !is.na(Delta_CD4_CD8),
    is.finite(.pred),
    is.finite(Delta_CD4_CD8)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit linear model and calculate distance to line
# --------------------------------------------------

lm_fit <- lm(Delta_CD4_CD8 ~ .pred, data = pred_df)

# 🔥 Compute R² (robust way)
rsq_optimal_delta_cd4_cd8 <- summary(lm_fit)$r.squared

pred_df <- pred_df |>
  mutate(
    fitted_line = predict(lm_fit, newdata = pred_df),
    distance_to_line = abs(Delta_CD4_CD8 - fitted_line)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Scatter plot (UPDATED)
# --------------------------------------------------

p_pred_delta_cd4_cd8 <- ggplot(
  pred_df,
  aes(
    x = .pred,
    y = Delta_CD4_CD8,
    color = distance_to_line
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 SINGLE regression line (no duplication)
  geom_abline(
    slope = coef(lm_fit)[2],
    intercept = coef(lm_fit)[1],
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 R² annotation instead of stat_cor
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(pred_df$.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(pred_df$Delta_CD4_CD8, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(rsq_optimal_delta_cd4_cd8, 3)),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "grey80",
    high = "#C03830",
    name = "Distance to\nregression line"
  ) +
  
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted vs observed ΔCD4/CD8 ratio",
    subtitle = "Baseline proteomics prediction",
    x = "Predicted ΔCD4/CD8",
    y = "Observed ΔCD4/CD8"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_pred_delta_cd4_cd8

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/model", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Predicted_vs_observed_delta_CD4_CD8_R2.pdf",
  p_pred_delta_cd4_cd8,
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/model/Predicted_vs_observed_delta_CD4_CD8_R2.png",
  p_pred_delta_cd4_cd8,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```
